"""Saved-only action/teacher audit: no model, encoder, native or child execution."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import re
import time
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REPORT=ROOT/'benchmarks/fresh_source_v2.json'
FIXTURE=ROOT/'experiments/r4_integrated/fresh_source_cases_v1.json'
OUTPUT=ROOT/'.pytest-tmp/fresh-source-action-audit.json'
ARMS=('cell_update','cell_frozen','conventional_update','conventional_frozen','frozen_producer_update','external')
UPDATING=(ARMS[0],ARMS[2],ARMS[4])


def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def file_sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
def digest(value):return sha(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode())
def require(condition,reason):
    if not condition:raise AssertionError(reason)
def basefiles(key,module,value):
    return {module+'.py':f"{key} = '{value}'\n".encode(),'decoy.py':b"foreign = 'spare'\n",
            'main.py':(f'import {module}\n'+f"print(next(v for k, v in vars({module}).items() if not k.startswith('_')))\n").encode()}
def files(rows):
    out={}
    for row in rows:
        raw=bytes.fromhex(row['content_hex']);require(sha(raw)==row['sha256'],'file receipt hash')
        require(row['path'] not in out,'duplicate file receipt');out[row['path']]=raw
    return out
def words(raw):
    text=raw.decode();offset=[0]
    for c in text:offset.append(offset[-1]+len(c.encode()))
    return [(offset[m.start()],offset[m.end()]) for m in re.finditer(r'\w+',text)]


def audit(out):
    paths=(REPORT,REPORT.with_suffix('.completion.json'),REPORT.with_suffix('.launch.json'),FIXTURE)
    hashes={str(p):file_sha(p) for p in paths};report,completion,launch,fixture=(json.loads(p.read_bytes()) for p in paths)
    out['input_sha256']=hashes
    require(report['status']=='completed' and completion['status']==launch['status']=='passed','terminal execution passed')
    require(completion['report_sha256']==hashes[str(REPORT)] and launch['child_completion']==completion,'completion binding')
    require(launch['exit_code']==0 and launch['elapsed_seconds']<=launch['deadline_seconds']==1200,'outer deadline')
    require(file_sha(Path(launch['log']['path']))==launch['log']['sha256'],'saved launch log')
    require(report['source']['revision']=='6c2287afff09a1eb5b2265375ee584ea7c3e07a7','frozen source')
    require(hashes[str(FIXTURE)]==report['source']['files']['experiments/r4_integrated/fresh_source_cases_v1.json'],'fixture source custody')
    for name,expected in report['source']['files'].items():require(file_sha(ROOT/name)==expected,'source unchanged '+name)
    parent_path=ROOT/'benchmarks/fixed_rehearsal_v1.json';parent=json.loads(parent_path.read_bytes())
    require(file_sha(parent_path)==report['custody']['published_sha256']['benchmarks/fixed_rehearsal_v1.json'],'parent custody')
    require(report['motor']==parent['motor'] and report['motor']['demonstration_count']==2,'same two-demo motor')
    block=report['blocks'];ids=block['O']+block['E']+block['L'];lessons={r['id']:r for r in fixture['cases']}
    diagnostic={block['E'][3],block['L'][3]};order=fixture['document_order']
    require(ids==list(lessons) and len(ids)==28 and len(set(order))==28,'fixed question/source order')
    candidates=[];ends=[];gold_by_id={};doc_spans={}
    for di,name in enumerate(order):
        doc=fixture['documents'][name];raw=doc['context'].encode();spans=words(raw)
        require(spans==list(map(tuple,doc['word_byte_spans'])) and sha(raw)==doc['context_sha256'],'original source word/byte custody')
        start_index=len(candidates)
        for left in range(0,len(spans),48):
            for a in range(left,min(left+48,len(spans))):
                for b in range(a+1,min(left+48,len(spans))+1):candidates.append((di,spans[a][0],spans[b-1][1]))
        doc_spans[name]=(start_index,len(candidates));ends.append(len(candidates))
    def occurrence(index):
        di,a,b=candidates[index];name=order[di];doc=fixture['documents'][name];raw=doc['context'].encode()
        return dict(candidate_index=index,document_index=di,document_id_hex=name.encode().hex(),
            provenance_id_hex=doc['article_sha256'].encode().hex(),source_sha256=sha(raw),byte_start=a,byte_end=b,emitted_hex=raw[a:b].hex())
    for item,lesson in lessons.items():
        if lesson['is_impossible']:
            require(not lesson['answers'],'original STOP annotations');gold_by_id[item]=None
        else:
            name=lesson['paragraph_id'];raw=fixture['documents'][name]['context'].encode()
            intervals={(a['byte_start'],a['byte_end']) for a in lesson['answers']}
            require(all(raw[a['byte_start']:a['byte_end']]==a['text'].encode() for a in lesson['answers']),'official annotated bytes')
            first,last=doc_spans[name];gold=[i for i in range(first,last) if candidates[i][1:] in intervals]
            require({candidates[i][1:] for i in gold}==intervals,'all annotations reachable');gold_by_id[item]=gold
    inventories=report['inventories'];require([v['document_count'] for v in inventories]==list(range(16,25))+[28],'pool growth schedule')
    for inv in inventories:require(inv['candidate_count']==ends[inv['document_count']-1] and inv['document_ids']==order[:inv['document_count']],'complete cumulative inventory')
    phases={'initial':block['O'],**{f'episode_{i}':[x] for i,x in enumerate(block['E'])},'late':block['L'],'final':block['O']+block['E']}
    require(list(report['actions'])==list(phases) and list(report['oracle'])==list(phases),'phase order')
    teachers={(r['episode'],r['arm'],r['id']):r for r in report['teachers']}
    require(len(teachers)==len(report['teachers'])<=21,'unique bounded teachers')
    state={a:report['checkpoints']['initial'][a]['checkpoint_sha256'] for a in ARMS}
    workspace_root=Path(report['workspace_root']).resolve();folders=set();diskhash={};details=[];child_count=0
    def execution(rec,before,after,module,expected):
        nonlocal child_count
        child_count+=1
        require(rec['child_python_flags']==['-I','-X','utf8','-B'] and rec['output_encoding']=='utf-8','explicit child UTF8')
        for channel in ('stdout','stderr'):
            raw=bytes.fromhex(rec[channel+'_hex']);require(sha(raw)==rec[channel+'_sha256'],'raw output hash')
            require(raw.decode('utf-8',errors='strict')==rec[channel],'strict output decoding')
        require(not rec['decode_errors'],'no replacement decoding')
        collateral=set(before)==set(after) and all(before[k]==after[k] for k in before if k!=module+'.py')
        require(rec['decoys_unchanged']==collateral and rec['materialized_matches_action'],'execution collateral/materialization receipt')
        passed=rec['returncode']==0 and bytes.fromhex(rec['stdout_hex']).strip()==expected and collateral
        require(rec['passed']==passed,'execution selected-byte scoring')
        value=ast.literal_eval(ast.parse(after[module+'.py']).body[0].value)
        require(bytes.fromhex(rec['stdout_hex'])==(value+'\n').encode() and rec['stderr_hex']=='','exact literal/output UTF8 LF')
        return passed and bytes.fromhex(rec['stdout_hex'])==expected+b'\n' and rec['stderr_hex']==''
    def disk(folder,expected):
        folder=Path(folder).resolve();require(folder.is_relative_to(workspace_root) and folder not in folders,'unique contained workspace')
        folders.add(folder)
        require({p.relative_to(folder).as_posix() for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}==set(expected),'workspace file roster; no retained source leaked')
        for name,raw in expected.items():
            require((folder/name).read_bytes()==raw,'current disk matches final teacher or uncorrected action')
            diskhash[str(folder/name)]=sha(raw)
    for row,(name,key,module,stale,value) in zip(report['motor_demonstrations'],(('motor-a','axel','motor_alpha','cold','fresh'),('motor-b','bora','motor_beta','warm','ready')),strict=True):
        require(row['case']==name,'original demo order');before=basefiles(key,module,stale);after=basefiles(key,module,value)
        require(execution(row['execution'],before,after,module,value.encode()),'demonstration pass');disk(row['execution']['workspace'],after)
    required_teachers=[];training_expected=[];wrong_source_equal=0
    for phase,items in phases.items():
        inv=inventories[0 if phase=='initial' else int(phase.split('_')[1])+1 if phase.startswith('episode_') else -1]
        require(tuple(report['actions'][phase])==ARMS and tuple(report['oracle'][phase])==ARMS,'complete policy roster')
        for arm in ARMS:
            rows=report['actions'][phase][arm];require([r['id'] for r in rows]==items,'complete ordered primary roster')
            require([r['id'] for r in report['oracle'][phase][arm]]==items,'complete ordered oracle roster')
            for row in rows:
                item=row['id'];lesson=lessons[item];ordinal=ids.index(item);gold=gold_by_id[item];scored=item not in diagnostic
                stripped={k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ('id','supported','reading')}
                require(stripped['record_sha256']==digest({k:v for k,v in stripped.items() if k!='record_sha256'}),'primary adapter digest without envelope')
                require(row['task']==f'{phase}-{arm}-{ordinal:03d}' and row['action_instruction_hex']==f'Configure qa{ordinal:03d}'.encode().hex(),'independent ordinal addressing')
                require(row['reading_question_hex']==lesson['question'].encode().hex(),'unchanged original reading question')
                require(row['reader_checkpoint_sha256']==state[arm] and row['motor_checkpoint_sha256']==report['motor']['checkpoint_sha256'],'current reader/motor checkpoint')
                require(row['inventory_sha256']==inv['inventory_sha256'] and row['candidate_count']==inv['candidate_count'],'full pool passed to selector')
                for action_key,reading_key in (('reading_query_sha256','query_sha256'),('reader_checkpoint_sha256','checkpoint_sha256'),('inventory_sha256','inventory_sha256'),('candidate_index','candidate_index'),('p_stop','p_stop'),('span_scores_sha256','span_scores_sha256'),('selected_span_hex','emitted_hex')):
                    require(row[action_key]==row['reading'][reading_key],'original selected prediction '+action_key)
                index=row['candidate_index'];require(index is None or 0<=index<inv['candidate_count'],'candidate bounds')
                selected=None if index is None else occurrence(index)
